entities.summary: Nathan Joseph Darling is a Canadian professional basketball player for Elan Chalon of the French LNB Pro A. He played college basketball for the UAB Blazers and the Delaware Fightin' Blue Hens. He is the first and only Blue Hens player in NBA history.
